# Decisions

## 2025-05-03 — omk sync completed, memory warning resolved
- Decision: Ran `omk sync` to resolve the previously reported warning about missing `omk.memory.toml`.
- Outcome: Sync completed successfully. Global hooks, MCP, skills, and local graph memory are all configured.
- Additional fix: Created symlink `~/.kimi/omk.memory.toml -> /Users/cheng/.kimi/omk.memory.toml` because the shell environment uses a temporary `HOME` directory (`/var/folders/.../omk-home-...`), causing `omk doctor` to check a separate `~/.kimi` path from the project-local `.kimi/`.
- Verification: `omk doctor` now shows `✅ Global Memory ~/.kimi/omk.memory.toml synced`.
- Remaining: 1 unrelated warning (`Git Clean` — 4 uncommitted changes on main).
